## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in George Town, Malaysia. It starts at Jalan Stesen, Bukit Bendera Air Itam,.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Mother Nature's got some of her best work on display here at this amazing Malaysian rainforest experience! Your Habitat Penang Hill tickets get you some up-close-and-personal time on the fringes of a 130 million-year-old virgin rainforest. Located on Penang Hill, you'll find yourself high in the sky before you even take the Tree Top Walk, with its 360º views of Penang.
>
> Learn about the bees, birds and bugs that call the forest home. Take a hike on the historic 1.6-kilometer nature trail, built in the early 1800s by the British East India Company, and bring out your inner child on three giant swings. Rainforest education doesn't get more 'natural' than this.
